## Purpose

Explain the concrete problem, intended behavior and Why.

## Scope and current state

List affected requirements/behaviors/cases, the implemented user journey, and remaining full-goal work. A partial PR is valid; do not call the whole product complete.

## Evidence

Identify the candidate commit, actual checks and environment, results and evidence paths. Distinguish real integrations, simulation, skipped/pending checks and long-run observations. Summarize relevant error/recovery cases.

## Interfaces and operation

Describe meaningful protocol, dependency, storage, migration, resource, side-effect or UI changes and their Why. Omit sections that do not apply; no mandatory ceremony for trivial edits.

## Continuation

Point to current task/coverage/checkpoint and next work. Review can happen while development continues; this PR does not request a new authorization for routine development.
